_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

sources.kind: Key Fact Statement, Credit Cards, Version 1.4 (PDF created 22 Apr 2026): joining and annual fees, fee waivers, interest, late fee, forex, fuel waiver, cash limits, reward notes for Unicorn and Nexteria
MITC, Credit Cards (PDF created 22 Apr 2026): same fee tables as the KFS

sources.read: plain page fetch; tab content read from the page source

open_questions: Reward points exclusions: the KFS lists excluded MCCs (jewellery, fuel, cash withdrawal, bitcoin, wallet loading, alcohol and wine shops, insurance) only for Unicorn and Nexteria. For the other cards the page says only "no reward points on cash withdrawals" (FAQ); the full list of MCCs that earn nothing is not published ("eligible MCCs prescribed by Bank time to time").

Fuel surcharge waiver wording differs: the card pages say "per billing cycle"; the KFS and MITC say "per month". The page wording is used. The surcharge the acquirer charges at the pump (the amount being waived) is not stated, and no minimum transaction value is stated except for UNI CARBON (Rs 200 and above).
KFS and MITC say all fees are exclusive of GST; the 18% rate is taken from the worked examples in the same documents (GST of Rs 36 on a Rs 200 fee).
Reward-point value: the card page states 1 Reward Point = Rs 0.25. The KFS and MITC do not repeat it.
Both PDFs are Version 1.4 with no printed effective date; the file creation date (22 Apr 2026) is the only date available.
Reward points on cash withdrawals: none (card page FAQ).
The page introduction says the card "comes with complimentary lounge access" but states no quota, so no lounge benefit with a count is recorded. Add-on annual fee Rs 250 (KFS).
